prompts.name: Basic Explanation
prompts.description: Explain a concept in simple terms with optional context.
prompts.template: Explain the concept of {concept} in simple terms. Context: {context}.

prompts.name: Trading Strategy
prompts.description: Generate a trading strategy based on market conditions and historical data.
prompts.template: Generate a trading strategy for {symbol} based on the following market conditions: {conditions}. Historical data: {historical_data}.

prompts.name: Market Analysis
prompts.description: Analyze market trends and provide insights with historical context.
prompts.template: Analyze the current market trends for {symbol} and provide insights on potential future movements. Historical context: {historical_context}.

prompts.name: Risk Assessment
prompts.description: Assess the risk of a trading strategy with user preferences.
prompts.template: Assess the risk of the following trading strategy: {strategy}. Provide a risk score from 1 to 10. User preferences: {preferences}.

prompts.name: Sentiment Analysis
prompts.description: Analyze the sentiment of a news article or social media post with context.
prompts.template: Analyze the sentiment of the following text: {text}. Provide a sentiment score from -1 to 1. Context: {context}.
